svg.title: Correctness and cost on the nine-task set: twenty-seven runs of ten configurations
svg.desc: Rows, one per configuration, for 27 runs of 10 configurations on the nine-task set: each row places the runs on a correctness axis (hollow without a page, filled with one, squares for Opus 5.5 or Sonnet 5.5 on the Opus 5 page, its 15 September version; those and Sonnet 5.5's first pass on a second, lower axis) and gives the gap, the verdict and the costs. Opus 5 high: 92 at $25.17 without a page, 97 at $27.41 with one (+4.9, better). Opus 5 max: 91 at $36.99 without a page, 94 at $83.75 with one (+3.1, better, just past the 3-point rule, agents 0 → 18). Fable 5.1 low: 90 at $18.85 without a page, 98 at $20.17 with one (+8.2, better). Fable 5.1 medium: 93 at $21.25 without a page, 97 at $21.70 with one (+3.5, better, just past the 3-point rule). Sonnet 5 max: 90 at $32.75 without a page, 87 at $38.86 with one (−2.8, level within noise, agents 1 → 7). Opus 5.5 medium: 93 at $10.30 without a page, 96 at $11.54 with one (+3.2, better, just past the 3-point rule); on the Opus 5 page 95 at $11.03. Opus 5.5 high: 95 at $14.94 without a page, 98 at $13.98 with one (+3.0, level within noise); on the Opus 5 page 96 at $13.32. Opus 5.5 max: 92 at $47.28 without a page, 96 at $51.86 with one (+3.3, better, just past the 3-point rule); on the Opus 5 page 90 at $87.80, 17 agents. Sonnet 5.5 high: 92 at $5.19 without a page, 96 at $8.38 with one (+3.4, better, just past the 3-point rule); a first pass, 30 September and 5 October, without a page 93 at $5.88; on the Opus 5 page 93 at $6.87. Sonnet 5.5 max: 89 at $31.78 without a page, 97 at $37.96 with one (+8.0, better); a first pass, 30 September and 5 October, without a page 93 at $36.21; on the Opus 5 page 91 at $77.07, 9 agents. Noise: one setup run twice side by side moved by up to 2.7 points, so a gap of 3 points or less is level within noise. One fresh session per task. How the pairs ran: Sonnet 5.5 high and max (both passes) ran without and with a page side by side, task by task (Sonnet 5.5 high and max, first pass, over 30 September and 5 October); Opus 5 max on the same day, at overlapping times; Fable 5.1 low and medium and Opus 5.5 medium, high and max on the same day, one after the other; Opus 5 high without a page over 2–3 September (Oracle migrate, No-change and Wide audit on 2 September, the other six on 3 September at overlapping times with the run with a page), with one on 3 September; Sonnet 5 max (2 September without a page, 3 September with one) on different days. Runs on different days moved up to 4.2: Sonnet 5.5 max without a page scored 92.9 (its tasks split between 30 September and 5 October) and 88.7 (on 5 October), 4.2 points apart. Pages: Opus 5, Fable 5.1 and Sonnet 5 (the last on the Opus 5 page) ran the first pages on 2–3 September 2026 (rescored on 22 September); Opus 5.5 ran its 22 September page and the Opus 5 page of 15 September on 22 September; Sonnet 5.5 ran the Opus 5.5 page of 29 September on 5 October, after a first pass without a page and on the Opus 5 page on 30 September and 5 October. Opus 5.5 high, repeated on its page: 96.4 (97.6 here); medium, run again on the revised 22 September page: 95.3, 2 agents. The pages that ship since 7 October were measured only on the held-out set.
